name: Circle of Spores
description: A druid who sees decay as a vital part of nature's cycle, wielding necrotic spores instead of shrinking from death.
note: circle_spells_by_level's "2" entry is a bonus cantrip (Chill Touch), not a slotted spell like the 3/5/7/9 pairs — matches real RAW's own irregular structure for this subclass.
